title: Preserve native launch errors in the opt-in Windows Git stream owner
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR5463's owned Python gate turns requested-executable launch failures into exit 1. With the actual Git reader's suppressed stderr, a missing executable, invalid image or directory-as-executable becomes an empty/non-blob response error.

This **opt-in tooling successor** preserves the native exception class and fields through a separate, bounded launch-status channel while reusing PR5463's unchanged Job Object owner. It distinguishes launch failure from a successfully launched exit 129, preserves binary streams and consumer pauses, and stops owned children on startup failure. A transient report-read PermissionError found during repeated native checks is handled within the existing startup deadline; a real executable PermissionError is reconstructed outside that retry handler.

Only `research/windows-git-launch-diagnostics/` is added. Shared production adoption remains open. No new kappa, selected-record change, full adapter acceptance or mathematical replay is claimed.

[Package and limits](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/tree/b11f5ab7df36fbde44e9f2de3498e3e77f2eb4ee/research/windows-git-launch-diagnostics) · [validation record](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b11f5ab7df36fbde44e9f2de3498e3e77f2eb4ee/research/windows-git-launch-diagnostics/VALIDATION.md)

## Task and overlap

Handoff-first `portable-replay`, **changed scope** from generic artifact comparison to PR5463's explicit launch-diagnostic obligation. Reliable source-pin checks need to distinguish process setup failures from bad Git data. [Task card](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b11f5ab7df36fbde44e9f2de3498e3e77f2eb4ee/research/windows-git-launch-diagnostics/TASK.json) · [canonical Discussion claim/result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4681#discussioncomment-19174004).

Started and refreshed against canonical main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`, priority revision 7. PR5463 remains at `991da9010925914ec64a5293286edb10a7910218`. PR5461 (`dd30c37b09bc090afa94944cb055b677de2db696`) and the 7a9a2b67 native probe retain baseline diagnosis credit; their full suites were not rerun here.

The full refresh covered 378 open PRs and 4,796 Discussion records; sparse local coverage omitted 7,401/7,402 tracked notes. Relevant sources, runner documentation and ledger were read directly. A later live thread/PR check found two concurrent diagnostic claims released; their preliminary corroboration is credited, not claimed as independent review. Owner-death audits remain separately coordinated. These searches do not prove novelty.

## Validation

Native Windows 11 build 26300 / CPython 3.12.0, standard library:

```text
python -I -W error -B research/windows-git-launch-diagnostics/verify.py --require-windows
python -I -W error -O -B research/windows-git-launch-diagnostics/verify.py --require-windows
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/windows-git-launch-diagnostics
python -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/windows-git-launch-diagnostics --check-source-history
```

- Direct normal/optimized and registered normal/optimized checks pass **25 case groups**. Complete case arrays agree across modes.
- Controls cover native launch fingerprints, exactly-once exit-129 fallback, 80,000-byte binary duplicate reads, Unicode argv/env/cwd, consumer suspension, malformed/missing/oversized status, transient/persistent report-read denial, assignment denial, and four retained-handle descendant boundaries before teardown.
- Three deliberate regressions are detected: omitted handshake, stdout contamination and corrupted frozen source. Fifty additional focused diagnostic cycles pass after the read-denial repair; the earlier failures and their diagnosis are preserved in VALIDATION.
- All 17 committed files and canonical source-history pins pass. The official export/check passes. Its file-read-only, Git-free native optimized replay passes all 25 groups in 8.30 s, reproduces the **entire parsed optimized receipt with zero exclusions**, and leaves every exported byte unchanged. Directory ACLs were not made read-only.
- Ubuntu/WSL2 / Python 3.12.3 passes explicitly labelled portable source/report checks; `--require-windows` rejects there. This is not native Windows coverage.

Science/evidence: `68f3e912d04d74fbb98b806852007f7231a8b1af`. Publication: `b11f5ab7df36fbde44e9f2de3498e3e77f2eb4ee`; the second commit only records export/provenance results. The pending fork dependency is vendored with exact blob/SHA256 identities and public provenance, not misrepresented as a canonical ancestor.

Not run: full predecessor/production-consumer suites, other Windows hosts, restrictive host policies, hard owner-death tests or scientific replays. General Popen compatibility and a total wall-clock bound including outer CreateProcess/filesystem calls are not claimed. Hosted CI is separate.

## Credit

Retain ywz65's Job Object/gate and native observer design; Brian/JoyboyBrian's deadlines/POSIX ownership; Nick Petalas's blob/fallback reader; Douglas Colkitt's runner; Mihir Srivastava's adapter/native audit lineage; Arham Tahir, Woklerx, yssite, Paul Romeo, Tekalign and the retained contributors. Concurrent missing-executable corroboration is linked in VALIDATION. Source notices and Apache-2.0 license are included.

Prepared for Mihir Srivastava with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent. Author-checked, not independently human-reviewed.

## Open next questions

[Detailed next questions](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b11f5ab7df36fbde44e9f2de3498e3e77f2eb4ee/research/windows-git-launch-diagnostics/README.md#open-next-questions): integrate the reviewed owner/wrapper at one shared process factory while retaining fixture seams, then run the current consumer suites on Windows/POSIX. A second Windows host/policy replay is also useful. These require separate review/host access; this contribution reserves neither task.
